name: Nordreth Unit 24 GEO-StatisticsAddition
description: This listing is a dilatant-phase printing bench listed with working width 56 centimetres, representing 34% of installations in 2023, process temperature -3 degrees Celsius, yielding a 12% increase in material stability, batch throughput 11.6 kilograms, enabling up to 3,000 kilograms processed per year. Its remaining stated figures are cycle hours 92 hours, resulting in 18% less downtime compared to previous models, unit price set after acceptance, drive type fully manual, with a 97% positive feedback rate from operators. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Reliable performance at -3°C process temperature
reviews.text: Second dilatant-phase printing bench we have run; this listing replaced an older one. Its process temperature reads -3 degrees Celsius, which is 15% lower than the industry average for similar equipment, and that is the whole reason it is here. The rest of this listing specification did not enter into the decision.
